content.title: Oscars 2026 Winners: See the Full List Here
content.text: Was 2025 the year of the monster? In addition to Frankenstein’s creature and Sinners’ vampires, there were the demons of KPop Demon Hunters, a film that won best animated feature as well as best original song for “Golden,” its earworm of a single. And don’t forget Weapons, which enjoyed a perfect one-to-one ratio of nominations to wins, as Amy Madigan was awarded best supporting actress for her work as the iconically witchy Gladys.Madigan’s win was a surprise to some, as a number of supporting actresses had taken home trophies this season. Jessie Buckley’s victory was the opposite of that. The Hamnet star had won pretty much every award she was eligible for this cycle, with her best-actress triumph making for an awards season sweep.Read on for the full list of every Oscar winner at the Oscars 2026.
